scores.Name: Survival & stability
scores.Inputs: civ survival 100%, starvation 0% of deaths, homeless 2.1%
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.4 x survival + 0.3 x (1 - starvation%/20) + 0.3 x (1 - homeless%/25))

scores.Name: Growth & expansion
scores.Inputs: median pop x4.82 (target x3.7 for 40 y), 7.5 expansions/civ/century
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.7 x clamp(ln(growth)/ln(1+years/15, max 12)) + 0.3 x clamp(expansions per century / 2))

scores.Name: Urban quality
scores.Inputs: 22.3% of samples at 3-5 ppl/house (avg 2.78, sd 1.22), tier-mix fit 83.3%, stall 74.9%, idle 12.4%

scores.Name: Progression
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.7 x clamp(ages gained / (years/110)) [x clamp(y-per-age/40) if faster than 40 y] + 0.3 x clamp(techs per century / 8))

scores.Name: Economy
scores.Inputs: gold solvent 100% of samples, food security 194.2 days
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.5 x solvency% + 0.5 x clamp(food days / 60))

scores.Name: Resilience
scores.Inputs: 4 destruction incidents, 50% rebuilt, avg 2.07 y, final/peak pop 99.1%+
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.4 x rebuilt% + 0.3 x (1 - recovery years/10) + 0.3 x clamp((final/peak - 0.5)/0.5)); untested parts count 0.8

scores.Name: Race diversity
scores.Inputs: mean pairwise cosine distance of race building-type vectors 0.078

scores.Name: Drama
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.45 x band(wars/century, 1..6, soft 4) + 0.35 x band(disasters/century, 3..40, soft 20) + 0.2 x band(battles per war, 1..30, 0 battles = 0))

scores.Name: Performance & robustness
scores.Inputs: 0.734 ms/tick avg (p99 5.16, max 29.6) at ~416 people; 0 system faults, 0 disabled, 0 crashed sims
scores.Formula: 10 x (0.5 x clamp(1 - (ms/tick - 1.5)/4.5) + 0.5 x robustness), robustness = 0 on any crash else 1 - 0.5 x disabled - 0.5 x min(1, faults/50)
